purpose: R25conf Grok P2-M1: continuous uniform-hyperprior marginalization over sigma_theory in [0.5, 2.0] vs the discrete grid of Sec. VI / tab:bayes.
conventions: identical to committed c9g/c9k; fhat = -35/8, sigma = 0.7

continuous_marginal.note: Marginal BF (broad 8.84, narrow 3.62) lies between the discrete sigma_theory = 0.5 and 2.0 endpoints (broad 13.91/5.65) and close to the recommended sigma_theory = 1.0 values (broad 9.80, narrow 4.01); BF > 1 (bounce over tuned multifield) holds across the entire hyperprior support, so the ranking is stable under continuous prior-width variation. 3-point grid converged to < 0.03 in log-evidence vs the 10001-point grid.
